title: Signed index agrees with shifted word
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $xb$ assign a bit to each natural number, and suppose $xb(j)=x_j$ for every $j<|x|$. For every integer $d$, the following expression equals the symbol of $x$ shifted to position $1+d$: it is blank if $d<0$ and $d\ne0$, equals $xb(|d|)$ if $|d|<|x|$ otherwise, and is blank if $|d|\ge |x|$ otherwise.
